name: Retention and Erasure Decision — 2026-07-07
description: A Data Protection Officer ruling issued on 2026-07-07 that denies erasure of customer data while incident, complaint, regulatory assessment, and AML-related holds remain open. The decision establishes a hold review date of 2026-10-07 and specifies differential treatment of data categories: marketing preferences to be suppressed if requested, duplicate copies to be restricted and reviewed, incident/complaint records to be retained and restricted, and AML/KYC/transaction evidence to be retained under regulatory obligation.
context: Status | Active legal and regulatory hold
Review the hold on 2026-10-07 and after all matters close.
